name: Deore LX pedal pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed left/right super-low-profile pedal pair with resin bodies and steel plates, BC 9/16 × 20 TPI threads. The 1991 table gives 326 g for the pair; toe clips and reflectors are illustrated but their inclusion in that weight is not specified.
